category_title: Students with AS/ADHD experiencing sensory overload and executive function difficulties
scenario_title: Managing semester-long assignments in multiple subjects
minimal_context: The student is sitting with a tutor at the beginning of the semester to plan and organize schoolwork using maths, Swedish, and English textbooks.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Welcome to the beginning of the semester. Here are your maths, Swedish, and English textbooks. We have two semesters ahead of us, so let's look at all the assignments you need to complete.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I remember having a hard time learning things, especially maths, which I still struggle with.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You can go to another room and do the assignments if it helps you concentrate.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Of course I could be in a quiet room but that doesn't provide the right support anyway. I just think of when assignments have to be finished, and how many assignments that have to be finished.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Well, we need to plan out your time management for the whole year. Just try to organize the chapters.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Saying 'now we have two semesters ahead of us' and having a maths textbook, a Swedish textbook, and an English textbook all at the same time makes everything seem endless. I can't organize this, it just creates a feeling of reluctance toward school.

task.content: Planning and organizing schoolwork using textbooks from maths, Swedish, and English for the semester

context.environment: General classroom or separate quiet room
context.materials: Maths textbook, Swedish textbook, and English textbook

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Being presented with a maths textbook, a Swedish textbook, and an English textbook all at the same time for the two semesters ahead
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Expressing that everything seems endless, experiencing difficulties with executive functioning including planning, organization, and time management
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Feeling stressed and unable to let go of thoughts of when assignments had to be finished and how many assignments had to be finished
related_quotes: We’ll have a maths textbook, a Swedish textbook, and an English textbook” all at the same time, making everything seem endless
it was less stressful and I could let go of thoughts of when assignments had to be finished, how many assignments that had to be finished, and when you don’t know, you just think of when and how.

behavior_patterns.condition: When facing long-term deadlines and large amounts of material
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Failure to complete homework, reluctance toward school, frequently skipping school, and dropping out of high school
related_quotes: This created a feeling of reluctance toward school, with some participants frequently skipping school and dropping out of high school.
